'''Tulak Hord's Madness''', also known as '''Tulak's Madness''', was a mental affliction that was the result of [[Tulak Hord]]'s manipulation of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] in his artifacts. Many of Hord's artifacts drove their owners mad in the [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] after his [[Death/Legends|death]]; the Madness was unique in that it only affected the weak-willed and drove them to delusions of self-grandeur and ultimately self-destruction.
